title: Concept: Package repository credential stored in a committed file
description: auth.json declares a literal repository password in `auth.json`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a literal repository password in `auth.json`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through auth.json (composer).
risk: A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a literal repository password in `auth.json`.
